scope: off-chip HBM behavioral model only; native addresses/hash/timing preserved
cases: default base0 valid write, true write ACK and readback
production base0x28800000 valid write, true write ACK and readback
below window or zero-length, above window, crossing end rejected before model access
sticky invalid fault even ready0; no alias writes
all positive/invalid checks repeated with SYNTHESIS defined
window exceeding30bit native bound fails at time0
limitations: behavioral model regression; no hardware/physical qualification
underlying model modulo backing array retained; contiguous K_MEM window is alias-free
